evidence.quote: For 2026-03-31, 57 holdings whose bdc_dimensions_raw lacks the schedule category delimiter ' | ' sum to fair value 322187000. The extracted total is 6126744000; removing these leaked incomplete-axis rows gives 5804557000, exactly the validated anchor.

The same predicate is deliberately quarter-scoped: incomplete-axis rows comprise the primary representation in 2023-03-31 through 2025-09-30, whereas 2026-03-31 also contains the category-qualified schedule representation.

rationale: The March 2026 extraction leaked a second, incompletely dimensioned representation for part of the schedule into unified holdings. These rows have only investmentidentifieraxis and omit the schedule category suffix used by the valid March schedule rows. Their fair value equals the entire conservation overshoot exactly. They are representation leaks, not additional economic positions, so excluding only this quarter's incomplete-axis rows preserves the category-qualified schedule and does not alter quarters where the older dimension form is the primary representation.
